decisionsTitle: The facelift, phase 4: the calendar's chips, colours, next event and subscribe box (amending §692, §292, §413, §487, §574)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-11**, approving the redesign plan (§692, `docs/REDESIGN.md`) and attaching the calendar's mock-up: phase 4 of the facelift is the calendar — the title block, filter chips with the kind, three colours with a legend, the next-event panel and the subscribe box — built behind «Aspectul nou» (§708) with the plan's defaults for its open questions: no hero photo on the calendar; the chips carry the kind and the surface and the collapsed «Filtre» panel keeps the rest; a separate Outlook row with its host in `PROVIDER_HOSTS`. Amends §692 (phase 4 is `building`), §292, §413, §487 and §574 under the look only. **With the setting off the calendar is today's to the pixel and reads nothing more**; the backoffice never changes.

**Where the mock-up was not followed.** Its accent is blue; decision 1 made the accent the pink (§708), so the active chip, the eyebrow and the button are the pink `primary`, and the weekly runs' colour is the pink tint. Its «Alergăm împreună în Brașov.» in a hand face is left out: Caveat is the home page's (`docs/REDESIGN.md` § The visual system). Its ✕ on the next-event panel is left out: closing it needs a script and nothing would bring it back. Its «CALENDAR» eyebrow over a different heading is the page's one `h1` «Calendar», drawn as the eyebrow from `sm`, so the heading a screen reader lands on is still the page's name.

**Decision — the title block (amending §292).** The kit-face wordmark still heads the calendar above its one `h1` (`tests/unit/theme/wordmark.test.ts` is unchanged); under the look it is drawn in `accent`. From `sm` the `h1` «Calendar» becomes a small uppercase eyebrow in `accentInk`, and under it stand «Planifică-ți următoarea alergare.» / "Plan your next run." in Inter 800 at −0.02 em, its last word in `accent` as a `span` (not a gradient), and the subline «Vezi când alergăm, unde ne întâlnim și ce ți se potrivește.»; today's intro sentence is hidden under the look (`OFF_UNDER_LOOK`, the new half of `onlyUnderLook` in `theme/look.ts`). On a phone the block is the `h1` and its «?» as §487 left them: the line and the subline are not drawn below `sm`, so the first week stays above the fold.

**Decision — the kind as a filter (amending §413 and §574).** One more question of the address: `?kind=weekly` or `?kind=special` (`events/domain/calendar-kind.ts`), from §709's `eventKind`, at most one — the first value that names a kind wins, anything else is ignored as `?type=NOPE` always was. It lives in the query on the period's own path like every filter (§574), and the live twin answers it (`i18n/live-twin.ts`); the listing does not read it (its look is phase 5's), so it is not one of `FILTER_GROUPS` and the listing's panel never offers it. The calendar's period links keep it, and the «Filtre» form carries it as a hidden input (`carry`), so ticking a box never drops the chosen kind.

**Decision — `KindChips`, always visible.** A Server Component with typed props (the period's path, the kind, the filter, the surfaces the period offers): «Toate evenimentele», «Alergări săptămânale», «Evenimente speciale» — one choice — then the period's surfaces, each a tick of the panel's own `?surface=`. Every chip is a `ChipLink` to the address with that choice made and every other filter kept, in the closed set's order (one address per state), so the chips work with scripts off and with one are a soft navigation that keeps the scroll. A chip's word beside its glyph from the public registry (`club`, `repeat`, `special`, `surface:*`); the active one wears `aria-current="page"`. The row is one 44-pixel sideways strip at every width (CSS scroll-snap, no island), scrolled where it does not fit, so a month with one more surface never wraps a second line and moves the arrows (§575). **The panel keeps the rest:** `ListingFilterPanel` takes `lookChips` (the calendar passes `["surface"]`); under the look only, that group's fieldset and its active chips are hidden and the button counts the other ticks; the boxes stay in the form, ticked as the address says, so a native submit and `FilterAutoApply` (which reads the form's own `FormData`) keep them. `CalendarFilterSlot` takes `shownUnderLook`, so a month whose only offer is a surface holds the panel unseen under the look as §575 holds it today. The listing passes nothing and is unchanged.

**Decision — three colours by kind, with a legend.** A weekly run in the pink tint, a special event in the green, and **another date** in the warm grey: a special date where no one runs, a coffee or a shoe-testing evening (`calendarTone`). The filter keeps §709's two kinds, so «Evenimente speciale» shows the green and the grey together. The tokens are one table, `CALENDAR_TONE_TOKENS` in `theme/brand-pairs.ts` (fill, the words on it, the dot), and `tests/unit/theme/brand.test.ts` holds its eighteen pairs at AA in both schemes — the words on each fill, each dot on the page and on a card. The styles are `events/ui/calendar-tone-sx.ts`, written under `UNDER_LOOK` and its new dark twin `UNDER_LOOK_DARK`: a calendar entry takes its kind's fill and a leading dot (not drawn in a phone's 40-pixel column, where the fill says it), a race is no longer the one filled entry under the look, and off nothing matches. **Never colour alone:** `CalendarLegend` under the grid says each colour's word, and every entry keeps its glyphs and its accessible name. The grid becomes a card with a 16-pixel radius on the paper.

**Decision — `NextEventPanel`.** «Următorul eveniment»: the soonest date still going ahead that the page's own filters and kind let through (`domain/next-event.ts`; a cancelled date never, one already running yes), from the listing's cached upcoming rows (`cachedUpcomingEvents`, the read the header's «Vino cu noi» already makes). Its day in words, a pill naming the panel, the title as an `h2`, the time and the place, the route pills exactly as a card draws them (`buildRoutePills`) with the forecast at the start as their last (§402, §429), and «Vezi detalii» to the event's page (`ArrowButtonLink`). In the second column from `md`, under the month on a phone. **Read only while the look is on**, as the header's button is (§708): the page asks `cachedSiteLook()` and, off, reads no upcoming rows and no forecast, so the static calendar keeps its day-long life; on, the forecast's hour-long cache holds the page an hour (§549's rule for `unstable_cache` in a prerender). A failed read is no panel. The page then carries the `settings` tag, so a look save makes it again.

**Decision — `SubscribeBox`.** «Vrei să nu ratezi alergările?» / "Don't want to miss a run?" with one sentence naming the club, and one 44-pixel row each: Google Calendar's add link, Apple's `webcal://`, **Outlook's own** `outlook.live.com/calendar/0/addfromweb` on the feed's plain address (new: today's «Apple / Outlook» `webcal://` is a link a PC's browser hands to no one; the host joins `PROVIDER_HOSTS` with its reason), the `.ics` file, and the feed's address to copy in a fold (`CalendarAddress`, §674) with the two-ways sentence and the hints. Every address from `calendarFeedLinks` and `APP_BASE_URL`. Under the look today's «Adaugă în calendarul tău» row is hidden (`OFF_UNDER_LOOK`); the phone's «?» fold (§487) is unchanged.

**The design page.** «Mostre» gains «Calendarul, sub aspectul nou»: `KindChips`, the legend, `NextEventPanel` on the sample race with the sample weather, and `SubscribeBox`, inside a box carrying `data-look-preview`, since all four are drawn only under the look. `docs/VIBECODING.md` → «Where things live» has their row; `docs/REDESIGN.md` § Phase 4, as built lists where each part lives; `redesign-plan.ts` marks phase 4 `building`.

**Refused.** Reading the setting to branch the chips, the legend or the subscribe box (rules under the scope, as §708 says; only the panel's read is gated, because off it would cost a forecast and the page's day-long life). The kind as a sixth `FILTER_GROUPS` group (it would add a box to the listing's panel, which is phase 5's). Two «Filtre» panels, one per look (two forms with the same names and two islands). A hero photo on the calendar (the plan's default). A brand mark for Google, Apple or Outlook (third parties' artwork; the filled Material glyphs, §318).

**The gate.** At 320 × 568 with the look on, the first week ends inside the screen, one `h1`, the chips in one row with 44-pixel targets, no sideways overflow; the chips filter with scripts off; both languages carry the same keys (`i18n/messages.test.ts`). `tests/e2e/calendar-look.spec.ts` switches the setting through «Setări» → «Aspect» as `header-nav.spec.ts` does, serially, on the desktop project with its own viewports, and puts it back off whatever happens.
changelogLine: - **The calendar under «Aspectul nou»** — always-visible chips for the kind (weekly runs, special events) and the surface, three colours by kind with a legend, the next event with its pills and weather beside the month, and a subscribe box with Google, Apple, Outlook, the .ics and the address to copy; with the setting off the calendar is unchanged. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the calendar with «Aspectul nou» on, at 320 × 568 the first week row of the grid ends inside the screen, the page has one `h1`, the kind and surface chips are one row of 44-pixel links with no sideways overflow, and every chip is a GET link to the period's path with that choice made and every other filter kept, so the chips filter with scripts off; with the setting off no chip, legend, panel or subscribe box is drawn and the page reads no upcoming rows and no forecast (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given `?kind=weekly` or `?kind=special` on a calendar period, then only that kind's dates are shown (§709's `eventKind`), the live twin answers it, the period's links and the «Filtre» form keep it, and a value that names no kind is ignored; under the look the panel hides its surface group, whose ticks the chips carry, and keeps its boxes in the form (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Under «Aspectul nou» the calendar draws a weekly run, a special event and another date in three colours from `CALENDAR_TONE_TOKENS`, each pair at AA in both schemes, and a legend under the grid says each colour's word (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
